eval.description: OpenAI open-ended adaptation of FutureHouse LAB-Bench ProtocolQA. Models get short-answer protocol troubleshooting items made from 108 multiple-choice seeds: a flawed common lab protocol, the failed wet-lab outcome, and a request for the fix. Graded for accuracy against expert answers; cards also report expert consensus and median baselines. Dataset and runner are lab-internal.
eval.summary: Tests whether the model can find the error in a failed lab protocol and give the correct fix.

versions.changes: OpenAI open-ended rewrite of 108 LAB-Bench ProtocolQA items with PhD expert baselining; refusal-adjusted accuracy appears on some cards.

scores.description: The short answer matches the expert fix for the flawed protocol (refusal-adjusted variants count safe refusals as correct on some cards).

metrics.description: Share of items graded correct. Cards also report pass@1 and expert consensus or median baselines.
